name: Mistreating Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to seek wisdom and understanding from the LORD rather than relying on their own insight, as true knowledge comes from Him (Proverbs 2:6; 3:5, 13). This divine wisdom guides us to act justly toward others, refusing to withhold good when it is within our power to help (Proverbs 3:27). Avoiding the ways of the wicked and recognizing the consequences of mistreating others is crucial, for the LORD’s blessing rests on the just while His curse is upon the wicked (Proverbs 3:33; 4:14).
